title: Desperation Day
cn: 第 16 集 · 绝望之日
novel: Barney [[declared|declare]] February 13th as Desperation Day. According to his theory, the night before Valentine's Day was the time when [[desperate|desperate]] women would do anything to find a date for the holiday. Barney [[planned|plan]] to take full advantage of this situation. He dressed in his best suit and headed to MacLaren's with a [[strategy|strategy]] in mind. He approached women with [[cheesy|cheesy]] pick-up lines and exaggerated compliments. To his surprise, many of them were not desperate at all. They saw right through his [[charade|charade]] and turned him down. Barney was [[bewildered|bewilder]] by the rejection. Meanwhile, Lily decided to surprise Marshall for Valentine's Day. She [[secretly|secret]] booked a romantic weekend at a bed and breakfast in the countryside. Marshall, not knowing about Lily's plan, had also arranged a [[surprise|surprise]] of his own. He had ordered a custom-made [[chocolate|chocolate]] sculpture of their faces. When they both revealed their plans, they laughed and agreed to [[combine|combine]] their surprises into one perfect getaway. Robin, who was single, felt [[lonely|lonely]] on Desperation Day. She tried to convince herself that she did not need a date for Valentine's Day, but deep down she missed being in a [[relationship|relationship]]. Ted told her that being alone was not the same as being [[lonely|lonely]], and that she should enjoy her [[independence|independence]]. Robin appreciated his words but still felt a [[pang|pang]] of sadness when she saw couples holding hands on the street. By the end of the episode, Barney managed to find one woman who was truly [[desperate|desperate]] enough to fall for his tricks. But when she started talking about their future together after just one drink, Barney [[panicked|panic]] and ran out of the bar. The gang laughed at his [[predicament|predicament]], and everyone agreed that love could not be [[forced|force]].

declare.en: to say something officially and publicly

plan.en: to decide what you will do in the future

strategy.en: a plan designed to achieve a goal

cheesy.en: trying to be charming but seeming cheap

charade.en: an act of pretending something is real

secret.en: in a way that others do not know about

chocolate.en: a sweet brown food made from cacao

combine.en: to mix or join two things together

lonely.en: feeling sad because you are alone

relationship.en: a romantic connection between two people

independence.en: freedom to live without depending on others

pang.en: a sudden sharp feeling of emotion or pain

panic.en: to feel sudden fear and act without thinking

force.en: to make someone do something against their will
